thesis: Docusign's confirmed fiscal Q2 2027 result showed revenue of $875.7 million, up 9% year over year including about 1.3 percentage points of foreign-exchange benefit, with issuer-reported U.S.-GAAP diluted EPS of $0.40 and adjusted/non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.16; management also raised full-year revenue, ARR and IAM-mix guidance. The counter-case is moderate, partly currency-assisted growth, but the raised outlook, IAM reaching 15.1% of ARR and stronger free cash flow keep the net read positive. The latest filing says the cited securities matters are closed, so no qualifying scheduled litigation or governance-history event was found.
invalidation: Management reduces guidance, IAM adoption fails to lift recurring growth, or billings and cash conversion deteriorate materially.

thesis: Braze's confirmed fiscal Q2 2027 result showed revenue of $227.2 million, up 26.2%, record second-quarter operating cash flow of $24.2 million and free cash flow of $21.7 million; issuer-reported U.S.-GAAP diluted EPS was a $0.17 loss and adjusted/non-GAAP diluted EPS was $0.19. The counter-case is the continuing U.S.-GAAP loss and an unremediated internal-control material weakness, so the evidence supports a positive read but not high conviction. The current 10-Q reports no litigation expected to be materially adverse, and no qualifying restatement, for-cause auditor departure or operations-linked indictment was found.
invalidation: Revenue or current remaining-performance-obligation growth decelerates materially, free cash flow reverses, or the disclosed control weakness produces a restatement or remains unremediated beyond management's stated fiscal-year window.

thesis: Samsara disclosed that Asplundh selected its AI dash cams, vehicle and powered-asset gateways, and asset tags across tens of thousands of vehicles and pieces of equipment, a confirmed company-specific deployment that supports platform breadth. The counter-case is that contract value and rollout economics were not disclosed, so the announcement cannot by itself establish material revenue acceleration and conviction remains medium. Current company filings describe ordinary-course litigation, and this run found no scheduled litigation event within roughly 90 days or qualifying governance-history event.
invalidation: The Asplundh rollout is delayed or reduced, disclosed economics prove immaterial, or subsequent results show weakening annual-recurring-revenue growth or retention.
sources: Business Wire via AOL, Asplundh selects Samsara: https://www.aol.com/articles/asplundh-selects-samsara-protect-crews-130000000.html

thesis: Innodata's confirmed Q2 2026 result showed revenue of $92.1 million, up 58% year over year, adjusted EBITDA of $25.4 million and issuer-reported diluted EPS of $0.41. The strongest counter-evidence is a planned September 30 CEO transition and the legacy securities allegations, but the transition was company-planned, the SEC and DOJ investigations closed without enforcement, and the court dismissed the second amended complaint without prejudice; those facts do not reverse the operating read or create a scheduled binary event in the next roughly 90 days. No qualifying governance-history event was found.
invalidation: Revenue growth or adjusted margin falls sharply, major-customer concentration produces a material contract loss, the planned leadership transition disrupts execution, or the securities case is revived with materially stronger allegations.

thesis: Viking Therapeutics priced concurrent offerings of 7,857,143 common shares at $35 and $225 million of convertible senior notes, with settlement scheduled for September 25, a confirmed near-term dilution event that explains the high-volume move. Positive VK2735 clinical progress and added development funding are the counter-case, but the enlarged equity-and-convertible financing increases share and capital-structure risk before commercial validation, so avoid a new entry. A pending Federal Circuit matter surfaced, but this run did not identify a scheduled ruling or hearing within roughly 90 days; the 2025 auditor succession followed the Marcum-CBIZ transaction rather than a disclosed for-cause departure.
invalidation: The offerings close without further expansion and subsequent company data materially de-risk VK2735 efficacy, safety, funding needs and commercialization economics.

thesis: Hafnia increased its TORM ownership and on September 23 launched a contemplated offering of its own ordinary shares to finance the additional stake and repay acquisition-related borrowing. Strategic consolidation optionality is the counter-case, but the fresh equity financing, added balance-sheet exposure and transaction uncertainty make the setup dilution-driven and low conviction, so avoid a new entry. The September CEO transition was disclosed as planned succession without a strategy change and does not meet the leadership-turnover flag; no qualifying scheduled litigation or governance-history event was found.
invalidation: The offering closes on favorable terms, leverage remains controlled, and the enlarged TORM stake produces clearly disclosed per-share economic benefits without further dilution.

thesis: TORM disclosed that Hafnia had raised its ownership to about 18.19% by September 18, and the subsequent additional-share announcement strengthens the possibility of strategic influence around a profitable product-tanker operator. The counter-case is that no takeover or combination is agreed and tanker earnings remain cyclical, so ownership optionality is credible but unresolved and conviction remains medium. TORM's auditor was proposed for routine reappointment, and this run found no qualifying scheduled litigation or governance-history event.
invalidation: Hafnia reverses or monetizes the stake, TORM rejects strategic engagement without an operating offset, or tanker rates and cash generation deteriorate materially.

thesis: Securitize's first public-company quarter showed tokenized AUM of $4.3 billion and transaction volume up 147%, but total revenue fell 5%, the issuer reported a $21.7 million net loss and diluted EPS loss of $2.37, adjusted EBITDA was negative $5.5 million, and fund-services AUA fell about 20%. Those offsetting fundamentals plus the post-de-SPAC price surge make the setup mixed and sentiment-sensitive, which requires low conviction and supports avoiding a new entry. A company-initiated trade-secret case against tZERO is active, but no scheduled ruling or hearing within roughly 90 days was identified; the pre-listing auditor change was not shown to be for cause.
invalidation: Revenue growth turns positive and repeatable, adjusted EBITDA and cash burn improve materially, fund-services AUA stabilizes, and post-listing dilution or legal risks remain contained.
sources: Securitize Q2 2026 results filed with SEC: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2094496/000162828026056164/exhibit991-secz2q26earning.htm

thesis: BOXX remains consistent with its disclosed objective of approximating one-to-three-month Treasury-bill performance through box-spread positions, and the near-52-week-high signal is mechanical accrual behavior rather than a company catalyst. That technical character caps conviction at low; derivatives, tax, liquidity and premium-or-discount behavior are the counter-risks, but current official fund materials do not identify a thesis-breaking strategy change or a qualifying issuer governance event. Continue holding the existing reserve sleeve without treating transferred value or unavailable acquisition basis as strategy profit.
invalidation: Official holdings or disclosures show a material strategy change, persistent abnormal premium or discount, liquidity deterioration, counterparty or clearing stress, or an adverse regulatory or tax change affecting the box-spread structure.
